mainValueProposal.D36537: Use independently traced unexpanded ERP upstreamExecution, preserving source record identity.
mainValueProposal.SMS132: No primary relationship evidenced; leave optional primary execution_no NULL until explicitly designated, preserve every execution relation.

relationProposal.meaning: Explicit sales-order to execution-number relation. Uses original execution number without requiring a CRM execution entity to exist.
relationProposal.sourceBinding: One independent binding per exact order business key + original execution number. No adoption of original task/bindings. Raw row identities remain traceable in retained source and evidence; duplicates do not create duplicate business relations.
relationProposal.scope: Only new independent P14; the relation model consistently carries nonempty execution relationships. No other task, CRM execution creation, authorization, migration or state-machine expansion.

proposal.alternative: Retain scalar-only formal model; requires explicit per-order primary-execution and non-primary relationship handling decision. Not auto-selecting max source ID or max execution number.
proposal.userDecisionStatus: SUPERSEDED_BY_APPROVED_MAX_ORDER_EXEC_NUMBER; original proposal was not approved or implemented.
